widgets.component: 'How many packs of hot dogs do you buy?' and 'How many packs of buns do you buy?' with no scenario
widgets.root: Root cause (all lessons): the practice-studio builder keeps each exit-ticket/connect.check follow-up question but drops the shared `scenario` that the questions depend on, so the stem reaches the student with no givens. Fix once in the builder (scripts/generate-practice-studios.mjs mastery assembly): prefix every follow-up stem with the scenario, or render the scenario as a passage above the item. The hot-dog/bun scenario (packs of 8 and 6, equal counts, none left over) is absent, so nothing tells the student the pack sizes or that 24 is the target.
widgets.replacement: 5.2 stem: 'Hot dogs come in packs of 8 and buns in packs of 6. You buy the fewest of each so the counts match exactly (24 of each). How many packs of hot dogs do you buy?' key 3. 5.3 stem: same first two sentences, 'How many packs of buns do you buy?' key 4.
